gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-besley: Besley is a classic serif with crossbars just a touch thinner than its stems, and its curves hang wide open. Besley reads with a dignified, editorial pace over a long page, while Comic Relief up top keeps every stroke the same blunt width.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-biz-udpmincho:
BIZ UDPMincho feels traditional and refined, its thicks mild and its gaps generous.

Comic Relief shouts in uniform, contrast-free strokes above it, while the serif below sits in a middle ground between monoline and sharp, so the two feel like a loud friend and a polite one.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bona-nova: Bookish and editorial, Bona Nova swells only slightly in its curves and keeps their mouths open. And Comic Relief above it is a plain stripe of constant ink, so a long text would feel gently shaped under a blunt heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bona-nova-sc: Comic Relief looks laser-cut, one cutting width from start to finish, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Bona Nova SC takes the opposite job, offering moderate contrast and small counters that stay unclogged, where the heading just makes noise.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-brawler:
Brawler reads literary and refined, with softly varied strokes.

Above it, Comic Relief keeps bold-looking and light-looking strokes from ever mixing in a word, so the heading hits hard while the text serif below holds an in-between contrast and clear openings in its rounds.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-brygada-1918:
Brygada 1918 feels traditional and dignified.

Its strongest quality is that worn felt marker swell, with curves lightening mildly toward the ends, set against the rope-like consistency of every stem, bowl and tail in Comic Relief.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cactus-classical-: Cactus Classical Serif opens its e wide and lets bowls shift weight gently, with an authoritative air. Cactus Classical Serif handles that quiet thickening at the shoulders, whereas Comic Relief does its best work in bold, uninterrupted line width on every letter.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-caudex:
Caudex reads authoritative and dignified, with gaping mouths on the e.

Comic Relief brings a monoweight skeleton up top, and the text serif beneath uses thick and thin strokes close enough to feel related, so the page has a bold voice over a steadier one.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Comic Relief skims along on strokes whose weight never changes, with bowls left unfinished on one side. And Chiron Sung HK follows with the soft variation of a lightly tilted nib, subtle until you look closely, so long text stays editorial and authoritative.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cinzel:
Marker-bold and blunt, Comic Relief draws one constant width.

Cinzel is a text serif with a modest gap between stems and hairlines, and its loose tracking and open c shapes give a longer passage room to breathe, classic and editorial in tone.
